_comment: V3DB (arXiv:2603.03065) zero-knowledge IVF-PQ verifiable vector search. Presets are the paper's ZK-optimized index configurations (Table 4); `candidates` is the per-query scanned set nprobe*(N/nlist). The comparison-count model below is the paper's own asymptotics for the prover circuit: probe selection baseline THETA(nprobe*nlist) -> optimized THETA(nlist); top-k baseline THETA(k*nprobe*n) -> optimized THETA(nprobe*n). `measured` are the paper's reported NET results (which include commitment/lookup machinery the model abstracts away).
